summary: Describes the Multicast Source Discovery Protocol (MSDP), which connects multiple IPv4 PIM Sparse-Mode domains. Each domain keeps its own Rendezvous Point and need not depend on those of other domains. The RFC is experimental and documents what existing MSDP implementations already do.

eli5.summary: Imagine several towns that each run their own radio station. This lets the stations tell each other who is broadcasting, so listeners in any town can tune into shows from another town.

questions: how do pim sm domains share multicast sources
